articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
articles.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

articles.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
articles.description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

articles.title: Hundreds of Italian schools hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
articles.description: Emails containing the false warnings were sent to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste and other Italian cities, officials say.

articles.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
articles.description: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

articles.title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
articles.description: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

articles.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
articles.description: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

articles.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
articles.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

articles.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
articles.description: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.

articles.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
articles.description: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.

articles.title: Judge allows Trump's $10bn defamation case against BBC to proceed
articles.description: But the court dismisses the other part of Trump's lawsuit that alleged the BBC had violated a Florida law.

articles.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
articles.description: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

articles.title: US warns Madagascar over growing military ties with Russia
articles.description: US general warns the Sahel model-like security deal with Russia could lead to greater instability in Africa.

articles.title: Tearful Smith switches allegiance to Netherlands
articles.description: Tatjana Smith, South Africa's most decorated Olympian, switches allegiance to the Netherlands.

articles.title: Watch: Vinícius Jr's surprise message to boy who received prosthetic legs after Sudan drone strike

articles.title: Watch: E-bike battery explodes into massive fireball inside Oregon home
articles.description: Surveillance footage from inside the home shows a mother and son noticing smoke coming from the battery before it suddenly bursts into flames.

articles.title: Why are these purple flowers shutting down streets in Sydney?

articles.title: 'If I tell you to run, run': BBC joins a Ukrainian drone unit as it protects a front-line city
articles.description: Slovyansk continues to be bombarded by Russian forces, making it almost uninhabitable with less than 10% of its pre-war population remaining.

articles.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted

articles.title: Why does Australia want Brits to swap Sydney for the outback?
articles.description: Australia wants changes to UK deal that would push backpackers out of Bondi and into remote regions.

articles.title: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
articles.description: Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy.

articles.description: The BBC gains rare access to a specialist drone unit defending the eastern city of Slovyansk from heavy Russian fire.

articles.title: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims
articles.description: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.
